prompt.adult: How many plagues did God send on Egypt?
prompt.child: How many plagues did God send to Egypt to free His people?
prompt.teen: God sent how many plagues on Egypt before Pharaoh let Israel go?
prompt.older: In the account of Israel's deliverance, how many plagues did God send on Egypt?

verses.text: And it came to pass at midnight that the LORD struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sat on his throne to the firstborn of the captive who was in the dungeon, and all the firstborn of livestock.

explanation.adult: Exodus 7 through 12 tells the series of plagues, and Exodus 12:29 is the last one. Count them in that stretch of the story.
explanation.child: The last plague came at midnight so God's people could go free. Count how many came, using Exodus 7 through 12.
explanation.teen: Count the plagues in Exodus 7 through 12. Exodus 12:29 is the final one. Match that count.
explanation.older: The deliverance from Egypt comes through the plagues that end with the firstborn in Exodus 12:29. Count that series.

teaching.extended_explanation: The series runs through Exodus 7 through 12 and finishes with the midnight event in Exodus 12:29. Count the plagues in that passage. Seven, twelve, and forty belong to other stories, not to this count.
teaching.takeaway: God sent ten plagues on Egypt.
